source.journal: Journal of Education and Science (University of Mosul) 25(3)

where: Abstract, p. 38 (the abstract describes a deep convexiclivate centrodorsal fovea and a shallow concave dorsotemporal fovea)
quote: The most important retinal specializations were the appearance of two foveae
note: The paper names the lizard Mabuya aurata, a listed synonym of Heremites auratus on the Reptile Database page for H. auratus (page opened), which lists Iraq in its range. By rule 3 this carries to other Heremites, so it bears on H. vittatus as a congener (g). The paper is a Mosul journal article with an internally inconsistent rod share (13% in the abstract, 23% in the Results per a PDF read), so its counts are not logged.
